messages:
deploy-bot: rollout complete for release v0.42.1 -> canary (10%)
deploy-bot: starting post-deploy quickchecks: smoke-synth-bucket, embed-short set, 5m window
alex: noticed p95 regressed on embed route in canary-east-1, +120ms vs baseline (n=120)
maria: which synth set? embed-short or embed-long?
alex: embed-short. sampling IDs: s-4721, s-4723, s-4730. logs show tokenizer latency spikes around token 6
sam: saw one probe return 503: `tokenizer: failed to normalize token at pos 6`
jen: can we scope this to canary only and pin embed model back to v0.41.8 for canary-tier? playbook suggests doing a canary pin if synth p95 delta > 100ms
alex: agree, sample size small but consistent spike across hosts. prefer pin to avoid exposing more traffic
jen: command to run: `deploy-bot pin-version --service=embed --env=canary --version=v0.41.8 --reason="tokenizer p95 regression"`
ops-bot: executing pin...
ops-bot: pinned embed-service (canary) -> v0.41.8. routing adjusted, propagating (~30s)
ops-bot: starting 15m focused synth watch on embed-short
alex: after pin p95 back to baseline (~-10ms). holding rollout and monitoring for 30m :thumbsup:
maria: adding note to release notes: "canary pin: embed route rolled back to v0.41.8 due to tokenizer latency regression observed in v0.42.1"
maria: creating follow-up ticket for tokenizer regression repro and root-cause in next sprint
sam: I'll attempt repro with quantized local build and the same embed-short inputs, will attach logs to the ticket
jen: good. keep the global rollout on hold until confirm no regressions in canary for 30m
ops-bot: hold applied to rollout. update: no new 5xxs in the last 10m
alex: thanks all. if stable after 30m we can resume gradual rollout, else escalate to rollback across environments
maria: noted — I’ll update changelog and send a short blurb for the post-release channel
sam: opening issue with repro steps and samples now
jen: assigning postmortem owners after we have repro. for now, follow pin playbook and monitor
ops-bot: monitoring continues. end of thread.
